    <h1>The Standard Model at the \(Z\) pole</h1>
  </header>

::: {.qft-exam-body}
Experiments at the Large Electron--Positron collider (LEP) at CERN were decisive for precision studies of the electroweak interactions.

\(i\) Consider the decay $Z\to f\bar{f}$. Neglect the masses of the fermions.

a\) Show that the total polarization of the fermion pair can be found by measuring the asymmetry $$A_{LR}^f = \frac{\Gamma(Z\to f_L\bar{f}_R)-\Gamma(Z\to f_R\bar{f}_L)}{\Gamma(Z\to f_L\bar{f}_R)+\Gamma(Z\to f_R\bar{f}_L)}.$$

b\) Express $A_{LR}^f$ in terms of the electric charge $Q_f$, the third component of the weak isospin $T_3^f$ of the fermion and $\sin^2\theta_w$ in the Standard Model.

c\) Compute $A_{LR}^f$ for the charged leptons, the neutrinos and the quarks.

\(ii\) Define the forward--backward asymmetry of the process $e^+e^-\to f\bar{f}$ as $$A_{FB}^f = \frac{\int\limits_0^1 d\cos\theta\frac{d\sigma}{d\cos\theta} - \int\limits_{-1}^0 d\cos\theta\frac{d\sigma}{d\cos\theta}}{\int\limits_0^1 d\cos\theta\frac{d\sigma}{d\cos\theta} + \int\limits_{-1}^0 d\cos\theta\frac{d\sigma}{d\cos\theta}}.$$

d\) Find $A_{FB}^f$ as a function of $\sqrt{s}$. Plot it.

e\) Show that at $\sqrt{s}=m_Z$ the asymmetries $A_{LR}^f$ and $A_{FB}^f$ are related by $$A_{FB}^f = \frac{3}{4}A_{LR}^e A_{LR}^f.$$

f\) Show that at $\sqrt{s}=m_Z$ $$\sigma(e^+e^-\to f\bar{f}) = \frac{12\pi}{m_Z^2}\frac{\Gamma(Z\to e^+e^-)\Gamma(Z\to f\bar{f})}{\Gamma^2(Z\to \text{ all})}.$$

\(iii\) Discuss how $\sigma(e^+e^-\to f\bar{f})$ and $\Gamma(Z\to \text{ all})$ would change if there were a fourth type of neutrino.

:::
